Explanation: Adds a color well to a form page that starts with the color given. The name is what a screen reader says.
Adds a color well that starts black.
Returns a copy of the well's color.
Returns the color as words: its hex code, then the name of the closest named color, such as "#4A5A6E, dim gray".
Finds a color well on a page by its name.
Changes the well's color from code. Listeners are not told.
Sets a Color from a hex code.
Returns the contrast ratio between two colors, from 1 to 21.
Tells the listener each time a person changes the color.
The action a listener writes. The event's GetColorWell, GetOldColor, GetNewColor and IsFinal say what changed.
